lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Wow... you really took care of that guy.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Yeah. Didn't even know I could pull it off.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: But, you know us Saiyans: We get stronger *every* time we almost die.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: So, umm... you seem like a busy man, so--

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Oh yeah, killing people. And I'm about to become immortal.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Well, we don't want to keep ya, so I guess we'll be seeing ya.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Yup, and I still got a lot to take care of, and I--

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Ohohohoho, oh, wait a minute, nice try...

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: You know, I could kill both of you right now, but after killing Zarbon and getting this last Dragon Ball, I'm in a good mood.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I mean, a REALLY good mood.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Next time you see me, I WILL be immortal.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Not that you stood a chance to begin with; I'm just... sayin'.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Well, congratulations. You’ve single-handedly doomed us all.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I didn’t see YOU do anything.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: What exactly did you expect me to do?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I dunno, maybe you coulda *bitched* at him, how 'bout that?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: That’s all you appear to be good for these days, huh?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Used your Bitch Fu on him?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Bulma, the Mistress of *Bitching*, that’s what they should call you!

lines.speaker: Vegeta & Gohan
lines.text: ♫ I'm havin’ such a good time ♫

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: 'Uh... I know - if I just hide here and lower my power level,'

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Okay, what the hell is going on?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I know I just sensed something down there.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Hey! Show yourself before I turn this place into a barren wasteland!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: So basically the same, only on fire.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Hi! Um... hello, Mister... Vegeta... Sir.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Well, if it isn’t Moe Howard.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: So what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Oh, you know - just flyin’ around.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Indeed. Stupid-looking watch you got there.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Yes; it tells time... and nothing else.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Well, yeah, that’s what a watch DOES... dumbass.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: So, uh, can I... help you?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: No... but maybe I can help you.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: By the way, I only hit you because I have pent-up aggression against your father.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Five ancient sages of bitchdom all gathered together one day on the peaks of Mount Bitch to proclaim your birth.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: And a hundred years later, when all the *bitch* stars had aligned, you were born and made everybody’s life around you a living hell because YOU ARE SUCH A *BITCH*!!!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: You guys... I think we should find a new location.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Why? What’s wrong with this place?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Because we have 10 minutes before Vegeta finds out that I just stole this.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: 'God, I love it when a plan comes together!'

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: 'Took some time, effort and lots of bodies, but now it’s mine.'

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: 'Alright - I’m going to close my eyes, and when I open them up, it’s going to be right here-- it's not here.'

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: 'Why isn't it here?! I don't get it! Who could've--'

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: 'The kid! But... how could he have found it?! He would...'

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: 'that watch was no watch at all!'

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: 'It was some kind of Dragon Ball locator!'

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Uh, Krillin... do you hear that?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: What the devil is that noise?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Ah, time for a delicious sports drink--

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: huh? What the heck is that?

lines.speaker: King Yemma
lines.text: Denise... Denise, do you hear that...?

lines.speaker: King Yemma
lines.text: Oh God, is that my wife?!

lines.speaker: King Yemma
lines.text: LEAVE ME ALONE! YOU ALREADY TOOK THE KIDS, WHAT MORE DO YOU WANT?!
Sounds of emergency sirens and burning buildings

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Alright, Mom. Once that Time Machine is done, I can go back into the past, to save Goku and my father--
Who is STILL screaming - from a different TIMELINE.
How the hell did his vocal cords not rupture?!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Alright... I don't think Vegeta will find us here.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Gohan, I need to get you to Guru's!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: So the old man can touch you and pull things out of you that you never knew you had!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Oh no, no no *no*! I am not letting you abandon me here again!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Those bitches on Lifetime might put up with it, but not me!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Bulma, you're right. You have been *very* helpful and *very* patient with us.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: So, in return... we're letting you watch the Dragon Ball. Bye!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: I WILL KILL YOU BOTH IN YOUR SLEEP!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: 'As soon as the Ginyu Force arrives, all of my problems will officially be over.'

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: 'Soon, immortality will be mine and the entire Universe will be under my foot!'

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: 'Oh, I wonder what I should do first? I guess I should start with what I *won't* do when I become immortal:'

lines.speaker: Acai
lines.text: Lord Freeza! The Ginyu Force is scheduled to arrive in five minutes!

lines.speaker: Acai
lines.text: Also, after rising concerns with our personnel... exploding...

lines.speaker: Acai
lines.text: we decided to form a union!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: 'Oh! First thing I'm going to do is go up to Cooler and slap him right in his smug, prick *face*!'

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: That's it! We're going to make it!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: We're finally gonna-- ...die! We are going to die!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Run, Gohan. Run as fast as you can.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Do as I say, for I am the Heavenly Buddha!

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: Guru, sir, we have another traveller from Earth.

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: Oh, tell me you didn't let him inside--!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Mr. Guru, sir, my friend Krillin told me that you could help us by... touching me.

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: Do I look Catholic to you?

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: Sir, I think he means he wants you to release his hidden potential.

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: Fine, stand still. It's your first time so I'll gentle.

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: Now relax as I reach deep inside you and grab hold of your essence.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Huh, that's odd. I don't feel anything anymore.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I wonder if we lost him--

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Dragon. Ball. I. Need. That Dragon Ball. Give it to me. The one you took. I need my wish...

lines.speaker: Ghost Nappa
lines.text: I think your rage broke, Vegeta.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I'm not crazy! *You're* crazy! *Especially* you, Nappa!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Ummm... I don't... really... have it.
Vegeta breaks out of his rage

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: How? Wait, what? Where am I?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Why are you here? Where's Nappa?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Yes! Of course I did! He's dead... forever.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Where's that immense power coming from?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Oh, that's probably Gohan over in the hut where the creator of the Dragon Balls is.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: You know, the guy who can unlock your potential by putting his hand on top of your head-- oh God, I cannot shut up when I am scared...

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Interesting! I'm gonna go pay him a... whaddya call it?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Beating! That's it... I'm gonna go pay him a beating.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: Hello? Can I help you with something?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Yeah, the first thing you can do is go die; save me the trouble.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: Ooh! Ooh, is this really happening? 'Cause I really hope it is.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Ohoho, trust me, you don't want any of what I am right now.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: Then come on, bring all four feet of you. Or should I count your stupid hair?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Pretty big talk coming from a bipedal slug.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: Big talk coming from a bipedal *bitch*.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Ohoho! Oh, I gotta admit, you are the best challenge I've gotten out of your people yet.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Then again, I'll have to compare you to all those villagers I slaughtered.

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: Stop making out with your boyfriend! I can hear it from here! It sounds like:

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I'm not here for any of you idiots anyway. I'm here for the old man.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: With this power-up, I'm now as strong as you were when we fought on Earth!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Congratulations! You're still weaker than the last 3 guys I killed.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Wow... I now know what it's like to feel like Krillin.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Look, it doesn't matter how strong you get, kid.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Besides Freeza, I'm the strongest thing on this planet!

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: Heeey! Just thought I would inform you all:

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: I detect several high power levels coming towaaards the planet...

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: ...there are five of them in total...

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: We're doomed. Don't you understand? We're all going to die here!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Whew! Alrighty! Time for a post-workout drink!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Nah! It's too early to get crunk.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Nah! Energy drinks just don't do it for me anymore.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I can't drink these! These are *nuts*!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Ooh, what's *this*? It looks delicious, and it's high in calcium!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: ♪ Doo doo doo doo doo, Team Four Star Soda! ♪

segments.title: Wakka Wakka
segments.quote: Next time you see me, I WILL be immortal. Not that you stood a chance to begin with; I'm just... sayin'. / Wakka wakka!

segments.title: Mistress of Bitching
segments.quote: Used your Bitch Fu on him? Bulma, the Mistress of *Bitching*! / ♫ Don’t stop me now ♫

segments.title: Thwartin' Mah Plans
segments.quote: Flyin' around? / Flyin' around. / Thwartin' mah plans? / Yes; it tells time... and nothing else.

segments.title: I Need an Adult!
segments.quote: Uh! I need an adult! / I am an adult.

segments.title: The Peaks of Mount Bitch
segments.quote: Five ancient sages of bitchdom all gathered together one day on the peaks of Mount Bitch... YOU ARE SUCH A *BITCH*!!!

segments.title: He Took the Dragon Ball
segments.quote: 'Which means... *which means*...!' / He tooook the Dragon Ball... / AAAAAAAAAAARRRRRRRRGGGGGGGGGGGH...!!!

segments.title: Screaming Across the Timeline
segments.quote: YOU ALREADY TOOK THE KIDS, WHAT MORE DO YOU WANT?! / ...Daddy?

segments.title: Do I Look Catholic?
segments.quote: You could help us by... touching me. / Do I look Catholic to you? / I need an adult...? / I AM AN ADUUUUULLLLL--!!

segments.title: I Think Your Rage Broke
segments.quote: Dragon. Ball. I. Need. That Dragon Ball. / I think your rage broke, Vegeta. / SHUT UP, GHOST OF NAPPA!

segments.title: Pay Him a Beating
segments.quote: I'm gonna go pay him a... whaddya call it? / A visit? / Beating! / Ah! Crapbaskets.

segments.title: Bipedal Bitch
segments.quote: Big talk coming from a bipedal *bitch*. / Naaaaail! Stop making out with your boyfriend!

segments.title: The Ginyu Force Arrives
segments.quote: ...and they're all increeedibly flamboyant! / It's-- the Ginyu Force (!) / We're heeere!
